population_source: US Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 population estimates by age (SC-EST2025-ALLDATA6), July 1
method: Age-adjusted: for each age group, the national NEISS-AI estimate for that age group times the state's share of the US population in that age group, summed over age groups. Simple: the national estimate times the state's share of the US population. Both are expected numbers, not counts; NEISS has no patient-state field. 95% ranges reflect the national sampling uncertainty (Taylor linearization, hospitals as clusters within strata).

forecast.method: National forecast (slowing-growth method, tested on past years) x the state's share of national visits in 2025 (age-adjusted). Assumes each state keeps its 2025 share.
